title: Issue #4283 pane.create probe persistence and phase telemetry
intent:
#4283 GREEN. Persisted probe store (24h, ~/.gwt/runtime/host_runner_probe_cache.json, Metadata/Package kinds only, invalidate on failure) wired into probe_host_runner_outcome; perf phase samples phase:pane.create.{worktree,docker,environment,runner_health,managed_assets,session,codex_pace} recorded from the launch thread.

Evidence so far: gwt-agent persisted/single-flight tests 10/10, gwt perf:: 53/53, clippy (gwt-agent + gwt, all-targets, all-features) clean, fmt clean. prepare:: module: 91 pass, 6 pre-existing Windows-host failures that inject a probe closure and never touch the new path (Linux CI is the anchor).

AC-4 finding for the Issue: the 15s / 30s plateaus are BACKEND_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT (pane.rs:47) paid once (pane.read / pane.send) or twice via the list_windows -> frontend_ready fallback (pane.list / pane.close); condition is a GUI event loop that does not answer within 15s, which is #4234 territory.

Baseline before the change (this host): route:pane.create n=200 p50 10457ms p95 61175ms worst 157244ms. AC-1/2/3 are measured after merge from perf.summary. Next: commit (pre-commit hook is running cargo test -p gwt-core), merge origin/develop, push, verify.plan/verify.run, Draft PR.
